pushSource.title: Push source (edge-collector ingestion)
pushSource.intro: This source pushes events to CentralOps. There are no poll credentials.
pushSource.createHint: Create it, then on the detail screen issue the token and point your edge collector at POST /api/ingest/<stream>. That screen generates ready-made snippets for FortiGate (syslog) and Windows Event Log (WEC).
pushSource.editHint: Manage the ingestion token and endpoint in this integration's ingestion tab.

sophos.clientSecretHelper: Leave blank to keep the current secret.
sophos.regionHelper: Optional. Automatically discovered on the first connection.
sophos.importNoticeBody: on save, each tenant here becomes its own Organization + Integration. Region and tenant_id come from the API.
sophos.enterpriseRequiredNote: Importing tenants requires Enterprise. On Community you can discover, not import.

syslog.title: Syslog sources (native receiver)
syslog.help: Devices that speak syslog straight to CentralOps (UDP/TCP 514, TLS 6514), no edge-collector. The network is the credential: only the registered CIDR is accepted; everything else is dropped and counted.
syslog.empty: No sources yet. Without a source, everything reaching port 514 is dropped as unknown origin.

form.rulesHelp: The first matching rule picks the stream. Use @fortigate, @paloalto, @cisco_asa, @pfsense, @linux_auth, @windows_vector or a JMESPath expression over the parsed line (msg, app, host, facility, sd…).
form.created: Source {{name}} registered. The receiver picks it up within 15 s.
form.deleteConfirm: Remove source {{name}}? Messages from that origin will be dropped.

autoApprovePolicy.howItWorksBody: This policy only controls the default behavior for new discovered tenants. Tenants already approved, excluded, or pending keep their current state.
autoApprovePolicy.toggleDescriptionOn: New tenants activate collection automatically after each sync.
autoApprovePolicy.toggleDescriptionOff: New tenants stay Pending, waiting for manual approval.
autoApprovePolicy.onExplain: When ON: each new tenant automatically creates an Organization, a child Integration, and three collection entries (alerts/assets/health).
autoApprovePolicy.offExplain: When OFF: syncs only update the snapshot. You decide tenant by tenant — or in bulk — from the panel.
autoApprovePolicy.footnote: This setting doesn't affect tenants already approved or excluded.
